purpose: Owner-attested emergency release evidence for the public macOS direct-download artifact after the v1.0.26 direct-download app was validated to be missing the Firebase Auth Keychain signing profile and needs to be replaced.

ownerAttestation.emergencyReason: Publish the newest-main signed and notarized macOS direct-download artifact after v1.0.26 shipped without the direct-download Keychain access group/profile needed by Firebase Auth. This v1.0.27 retry embeds the all-devices Mac App Direct provisioning profile and signs the app with the Firebase Auth Keychain group so users stop seeing the account-page Keychain error.
ownerAttestation.approvalBoundary: Emergency owner-attested soft approval for the v1.0.27 public macOS direct-download, app-store/TestFlight, Google Play, hosted gateway, and commercial distribution release train while the signed counsel packet is collected.
ownerAttestation.ownerStatement: As release owner, Alberto Nunez attests that Heather Meeker gave soft approval for this release boundary and authorizes the emergency v1.0.27 public release lane.

scope: app store and commercial distribution terms

commandEvidence.proof: The emergency release lane validates this structured owner attestation. It does not replace the normal signed external-counsel approval packet.
The stronger signed counsel packet remains required for the normal release lane once counsel signature material is available.

notes: Emergency approval is owner-attested soft approval, not a detached counsel signature. Keep the signed-counsel gate intact and replace this emergency packet with signed evidence when available.
